literal: In this birth we will not separate, when I said, eye-full water she took.
translation: When I said, "In this birth we shall not part," her eyes filled with tears.
modern: இப்பிறவியில் நாம் பிரிய மாட்டோம் என்று நான் சொன்னவுடன், அடுத்த பிறவியில் பிரிந்து விடுவோம் என்று எண்ணி அவள் கண்களில் நீர் நிறைந்து விட்டது.
explanation: The husband tries to reassure his wife of his constant love by promising they will never part in this current life. However, the wife's sharp mind catches the limitation in his words. By specifying 'in this birth', she infers that he might leave her in the next birth, causing her eyes to well up with tears. This highlights the extreme sensitivity and subtle overthinking characteristic of lovers' quarrels.
